verdict.rationale: Netlify documents its own AI Gateway for connecting to popular AI models from project code without managing API keys, so the core gateway capability is first-party. The evidence does not show breadth ("hundreds" of models) or a single unified endpoint, and there is no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of models, documentation of a single unified endpoint/API shape, list of supported providers, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint
